# The spice-bench decks under ngspice/src.assets with no adapted twin (the twinless block of the
# ngspice-vacask corpus census, `tests/test_pair.rs` spice_bench_twinless_to_vacask), one path a
# line relative to $SPICE_BENCH. The rule that made it (pair, 2026-11-13): a deck is a `.sp`
# file under ngspice/src.assets/{ngspice,paranoia}/examples; it has a twin when a file of the
# same stem (any extension) stands in a directory of the same name under ngspice/examples or
# ngspice/paranoia. 260 decks, 128 with a twin; the 132 without are 96 distinct paths below
# examples/, each listed once, the src.assets/ngspice copy where both trees hold it.
